Pulmonology Treatment in Ahmedabad & Expert Lung Care at Silver Touch Hospitals

Our Pulmonology department at Silver Touch Hospitals offers holistic treatment for respiratory as well as lung-related diseases. It might be a persistent cough, breathlessness, or an unfading chest infection; our seasoned specialists are here to assist..

Comprehensive Lung Care

Difficulty breathing can occur in individuals of all ages. From asthma to chronic bronchitis, our pulmonologists diagnose and treat a variety of breathing disorders with compassion, precision, and dedication.

As the best lungs hospital in Ahmedabad, we have a structured process starting with a thorough consultation, followed by investigations and treatment according to each patient’s individual condition. We always aim to alleviate symptoms, avoid complications, and enhance quality of life.

What is Pulmonology?

Pulmonology is a medical specialty that focuses on diagnosing and treating diseases related to the lungs and respiratory system, including asthma, COPD, infections, and breathing disorders.

Respiratory Conditions We Treat

Our pulmonologists are equipped to handle both simple and complicated cases, including:

  • Asthma
  • COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease)
  • Pulmonary infections such as pneumonia and tuberculosis
  • Allergic bronchitis
  • Interstitial lung disease
  • Sleep-related breathing disorders such as sleep apnoea
  • Pleural effusion and other chest fluid conditions

We also treat post-COVID respiratory complications, which can include lung scarring, weakness, or persistent cough and breathlessness.

When to See a Pulmonologist?

Don’t neglect frequent chest pain or breathing difficulties. You should meet a pulmonologist in Ahmedabad if you have:

  • Recurring cough that lasts longer than two weeks
  • Breathing problems while resting or exercising
  • Wheezing or tightness in the chest
  • Coughing up blood
  • Frequent lung infections

Early detection and treatment can help avoid severe complications and minimise long-term lung injury.

Advanced Investigations and Support

Our staff can also suggest imaging, such as chest X-rays or lung function tests, as part of your diagnosis. Although some scans are facilitated through external diagnostic partners, all essential evaluations are handled in-house by our staff. We also coordinate with departments such as general medicine and critical care for patients who require combined care.

Book Your Appointment

Breathing easily is not a luxury; it is a necessity. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our Pulmonology unit is dedicated to making you breathe easier and live more easily. Schedule your consultation today and take the confident step towards healthier lungs.
